senses.gloss: m. (תָּחַב) a shoot used for inoculation.—Pl. תְּחוּבִין.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:9">Tosef. Shebi. I, 9</cite> <he>אין תולין ת׳ בתאינה וכ׳</he> (Var. ed. Zuck. <he>תחומין</he>, some ed. <he>תחומן</he>, corr. acc.) (in the Sabbatical year) you must not hang shoots on a fig tree, nor inoculate &c.; Y. ib. IV, 35ᵇ bot. <he>אין תולין תוכין וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.), expl. ib. <he>מייתי יחור וכ׳</he> one gets a shoot of a fig tree, slaps (the barren tree), and suspends it on it, and says, this one bears, and thou dost not.
